messages:
ops-bot: Paging alert: INC-2026-0214 triggered — elevated 5xx rate on inference-api cluster. Priority: P1. Auto-notify sent to #oncall and #eng-releases.

alex: oncall here, joining. saw error spike ~09:11 UTC. routing errors to fallback started at 09:13.

maria: confirmed, I muted noisy alerts and started scaling up the pool + disabled the canary rollout.

jamie: rollback initiated for canary config (traffic-split -> 0%). command used: `rdeploy rollback canary inference-api --to stable-2026-03`

alex: thanks. early mitigation: roll back canary + scale up reduced 5xxs by ~60% by 09:28. still seeing intermittent KV cache evictions.

jamie: KV cache evictions correlate with a new compilation change pushed yesterday. digging into build metadata now.

ryan: collecting logs and the timeline into the post-incident doc: I've started a draft at /incidents/INC-2026-0214/draft.md — will paste here for visibility.

ops-bot: Incident acknowledged by alex, maria, jamie. Handoff suggested at 10:00 UTC for long-tail monitoring.

alex: agree on a handoff. we'll keep this thread for postmortem scheduling and RCA steps. short notes: customer-facing incidents count = 12 (errors surfaced to hosted API customers), mitigation window 09:13-09:42.

sasha: product - we need to confirm customer impact wording before external comms. will coordinate with legal.

kate (legal): I can review the impact wording. please add a short list of affected org IDs + the error window. keep it factual and avoid speculation on root cause.

maria: tl;dr draft timeline for RCA section (putting raw times here for the writeup):
```
09:06 UTC - deploy to canary (compile+push)
09:11 UTC - monitoring anomaly detected (5xx surge)
09:13 UTC - auto-fallback to model-variant A triggered
09:15 UTC - ops alerted and mitigation started (scale + rollback)
09:28 UTC - error rate reduced but not resolved
09:34 UTC - discovered KV cache eviction pattern
09:40 UTC - rollback completed / further scaling
09:42 UTC - customer-facing errors mostly cleared
```

jamie: adding contributing factors to the draft: 1) unsafe kernel selection in last compile, 2) insufficient canary throttle for heavy sequences, 3) telemetry blind spot for cache eviction patterns.

ryan: proposed postmortem meeting: tomorrow 14:00 UTC, 60m. agenda: timeline + root-cause analysis, action items, customer comms review, sign-off. Who can attend?

alex: I can. maria can you lead the ops mitigation recap?

maria: yep, I'll present mitigation steps and metrics.

jamie: I'll cover build/compile side + reproduction steps.

kate (legal): I'll join the comms portion to clear language.

ryan: sasha from product?

sasha: yes, I’ll be there for customer impact and follow-ups.

jamie: preliminary action items I'm putting in the draft: [A] revert kernel optimizer change unless we can prove safety; [B] add canary traffic cap to 5% for next 2 weeks; [C] add KV eviction metrics to telemetry dashboard; [D] smoke test for compile artifacts on staging. Assign owners?

alex: A -> jamie; B -> alex + release management; C -> maria + observability; D -> ryan + devex.

ryan: noted. I'll open action items in the PM tracker and link them to the postmortem doc: https://pm.redwood/projects/INC-2026-0214/actions

kate (legal): for the customer-impact paragraph please include exact customers affected (IDs optional) and the sentence: "Impacted requests experienced increased error rates between 09:11–09:42 UTC; mitigations were applied and service recovered by 09:42 UTC." I can refine language after I see the org list.

maria: added the org list to the doc. pinging @sasha to confirm whether we should send a push email vs in-console banner.

sasha: let's do in-console banner + targeted email to affected customers. need approval on the wording from legal before send.

alex: process notes for RCA: please ensure we separate timeline (facts) from analysis/opinions. include evidence snippets (logs, graphs) inline as attachments. Also add a 'Lessons learned' section with prevention tasks and owners.

jamie: on reproduction: working on a reduced repro that triggers KV evictions; will paste steps into the doc before the meeting.

ryan: timeline for peer review: I'll share the RCA draft by EOD today. please leave review comments by 10:00 UTC tomorrow so we can iterate before the 14:00 postmortem meeting.

kate (legal): I'll plan to review within that window. if legal flags anything, I'll mark it as 'do not publish' until we resolve.

maria: follow-up note: temp mitigation checklist created and saved at /runbooks/mitigations/INC-2026-0214.md — it includes commands used and rollback artifacts. use it for rehearsal.

alex: final sign-off flow proposed: engineering owners + SRE + legal to ack the final RCA doc in the thread. once all acks are in, product can publish the in-console banner and customer emails.

sasha: ack to that flow.

jamie: will ping once the repro steps are uploaded.

ryan: action items recap (quick):
- jamie: kernel change roll-back + repro (owner)
- alex: enforce canary caps + release ops updates (owner)
- maria: add telemetry + dashboard (owner)
- ryan: coordinate postmortem meeting, collect artifacts, publish draft (owner)
- kate: review customer wording and sign-off (owner)

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: postmortem meeting at 2026-03-15T14:00:00Z.

alex: thanks all. I'll close the incident once the postmortem is published and owners are tracking action items. please keep comments in this thread for the audit trail. :thumbsup:
